messages:
samir patel: Quick follow-up from today's postmortem — latency spike (p99 token time) uncovered a recurring pattern on quota-exhausted hosts. We need a short set of SLO/SLA updates and concrete owners for remediation + dashboard changes. Suggested immediate items:
- tighten p99 SLO to 250ms for model-serve route
- add error-budget burn alert with 6h window
- dashboard tiles for host-level queue length
Who can pick these up? I'm aiming to have owners + timelines by EOD tomorrow.

jessica li: I can take the dashboard tiles and the queue-length metric. Will add a heatmap and host grouping. ETA: tomorrow noon.

albert ng: I'll own the SLO proposal doc (what to change, impact on customers, rollback plan). Can draft by EOD today and post a PR to the sla repo. @samir patel do we want to keep current throughput target the same?

samir patel: Good. Keep throughput target for now — it's not what's failing. Focus on latency p99 and error budget. Thanks @jessica li and @albert ng.

tara davis: I'll investigate the quota exhaustion pattern and a mitigation plan (better backpressure and a lightweight fallback model). Timeline: preliminary findings by tomorrow afternoon, full remediation plan in 3 working days.

mike ramos: I'll wire the error-budget burn alert into the oncall playbook. Suggest alert thresholds: burn_rate > 2x for 6h or remaining_budget < 10% in 24h. I'll prototype today and push if green.

oncall-bot: Incident 2026-03-20-42 now archived. Root cause labeled: resource quota contention on infer-host-pool-3.

jessica li: Dashboard note — adding a grouped panel: host queue length, avg inference time, inflight requests. Linking to runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/latency-spike

albert ng: Draft PR: https://git.internal/redwood/sla/pulls/128 - includes SLO rationale and rollback steps. Comments welcome. TL;DR: move p99 target from 300ms -> 250ms with phased rollout (canary for 10% traffic 48h).

samir patel: Agree with phased rollout. Add automatic fallback policy to route to smaller-batch variant when p99 crosses 275ms for 15m.

tara davis: Noted. I'll add tests for fallback and a canary run tomorrow. Also checking if we need a short-term capacity bump for pool-3.

mike ramos: Alert added to playbook draft, assigning alert-owner @oncall-sre. Will post the link once merged.

jessica li: Uploaded dashboard draft to grafana: https://grafana.redwood/d/abc123/latency-insights - feel free to review.

samir patel: Great progress. Action summary:
- dashboards: jessica li — tomorrow noon
- SLO doc + PR: albert ng — EOD today
- quota pattern + mitigation: tara davis — preliminary tomorrow, full plan in 3 days
- alert/playbook: mike ramos — prototype today
We'll reconvene 24h after PR merges to validate metrics and schedule the canary. Call out any blockers here. :thumbsup:

mike ramos: no blockers from infra side. If capacity bump needed, ping me.

albert ng: PR updated with a note on customer impact matrix. Leaving a follow-up comment for product for communication cadence.

samir patel: Thanks team — reopening if anything shifts. Closing thread for now.
